احتشيتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَيْتُمْ (iḥtašaytum) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اُحْتُشِيتُمْ (uḥtušītum) /uħ.tu.ʃiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
